infectionStatus.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

value.en: Medical tests have confirmed that no infection is present.
value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为非感染者。

text.en: The Sargonian-Columbian Hadiya is a descendant of the Qarnsayf, a legendary warrior tribe of the desert. She joined Rhodes Island in Sargon as part of her ambition to improve her combat techniques. She currently receives training and participates in field missions at the Sargonian branch office of Rhodes Island.
text.zh: 哈蒂娅，萨尔贡裔哥伦比亚人，沙漠传奇战士部族剑角的后代。为学习战斗技巧于萨尔贡主动加入罗德岛，现作为罗德岛驻萨尔贡办事处干员，接受战斗训练的同时参与各类外勤任务。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Hadiya shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.19u/L
Before joining Rhodes Island, Operator Hadiya spent an extended time in the Sargonian wilderness without proper protection, resulting in BOCD numbers close to the infection threshold. As she is expected to spend significant time in the field, we have arranged additional tests in order to prepare proper protection for her. While Hadiya's awareness of the risks inherent in wilderness environments is lacking, she has proven cooperative with our work, which has greatly facilitated our efforts.

Based on her own account of her activities, she has been quite lucky to avoid contracting Oripathy so far. Unlike some tribal warriors, however, she is very receptive to scientific methods, and has already put in a request for other warriors from her tribe to receive similar checkups and training on Originium protection, pending approval by the Medical Department.
—Medical Department Note
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员哈蒂娅没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.19u/L
干员哈蒂娅加入罗德岛之前，在缺乏正确防护的情况下长时间活动于萨尔贡的荒野之中，她血液中的源石结晶密度测定结果几乎已经到达感染标准临界值。由于此后哈蒂娅小姐也将长期在野外执行任务，我们为她额外安排了多项检查，以便为她制定更好的防护方案。虽然哈蒂娅小姐本人似乎缺乏对荒野环境的完整认知，对外勤环境的风险评估能力尚有不足，但她十分配合我们的工作，这为医疗部的计划推进带来了极大的便利。

根据本人自述的活动经历来看，哈蒂娅小姐未感染矿石病纯属幸运。不过与部分传统的部族战士不同，哈蒂娅小姐对科学的治疗手段抱以很高的信任。她已经主动向医疗部提出申请，希望能够介绍同族的战士接受类似的检查与防护培训，此事已经提上医疗部的日程。
——医疗部干员

text.en:
Although Hadiya first encountered Rhodes Island in Sargon, and was assigned to the Sargonian branch after she was hired, it is obvious that she is not your average Sargonian.
Her style is very different from tribal warriors. She wields a staff with her right hand and a sword with her left, both containing complex mechanisms and axle-connected blades. The staff has foldable hooked blades on one end and a blunt hammer on the other, allowing her to employ both lethal and non-lethal means to neutralize enemies in close combat. Meanwhile, the short hilt of the sword makes it easy to perform thrusting motions when wielded on its own. An elaborate connector mechanism allows the two weapons to be combined into one, whereby the staff's hammer is retracted, the folding blades extended, and the shape of the sword's blade also changes, allowing her to respond to different situations and ranges. Hadiya had these weapons custom-made for her during her time in Columbia, and their design and construction clearly reflect Columbian technological thinking, making them very different from Sargonian weapons. The techniques she demonstrates in training are also different from traditional Sargonian techniques. She is an expert at utilizing cover and obstacles in close-quarters combat, relying on guile rather than strength, and creating an advantage through the versatility of her weapon. On the other hand, she is less comfortable fighting in wide-open spaces. She admits that she is still unfamiliar with the Sargonian wilderness, having developed her habits on the streets of Columbia and in training rooms. She recognizes that this is an area she needs to improve on as part of her new responsibilities, and she often approaches other Sargonian operators to pick their brains.

[Training Room Audio Log]
'Don't you find Hadiya's conversations with other Sargonian warriors really interesting?'
'What do you mean?'
'She always wants to learn the details of their weapons, how they're built, how they work, what environments they're good in.
'Most of the time, though, the only answer she gets is:
'Don't think. Just chop.'
text.zh:
虽然哈蒂娅本人是在萨尔贡第一次遇到了罗德岛的干员们，被雇佣后也一直分属于萨尔贡办事处，但每个人都看得出来她绝非人们普遍认知中的萨尔贡人。
最明显的是，她在战斗中就不同于一般部族战士。哈蒂娅手中常备有两把武器，无论是右手的战杖还是左手的单手剑，都带有相当复杂的机械结构和以轮轴相连的刃片。战杖配备的是可折叠倒钩状刃片，另一侧还装配着高强度的钝击锤，这让哈蒂娅能够在近身作战中对敌人进行缴械和致命打击。而单手剑则装配了较短的剑柄，在单独持握时能让哈蒂娅更加灵活地刺击。除此之外，它们还分别带有一套精密的铰接装置，能让两柄武器进行组合。组合时战杖的钝击锤会随铰接结构收起，折叠的刃片随即弹出，单手剑也会变更剑刃形状，以对应多变的战斗状况，适配不同的作战距离。这两柄武器都是哈蒂娅在哥伦比亚时为自己定做的，可以明显看出，它们的设计与制作都融入了哥伦比亚的科技化思想，与萨尔贡的风格相差甚远。另一方面，哈蒂娅在罗德岛的训练室中也展现出了不同于传统萨尔贡战士的战斗技巧，她更擅长障碍和掩体较多的近身作战环境，并且比起单纯依靠力量她更善于临机应变，利用手中武器的多面性来建立优势，反倒是在开阔环境作战中往往表现一般。聊到这一点，她痛快地承认对于萨尔贡的荒野来说自己还只是初来乍到，从小时候起她就只在哥伦比亚的城市街道和训练场中进行练习和模拟战斗，因此才有了现在的作战习惯。但她同时也表示，为了自己身上肩负的责任，她理应学会如何在荒野上作战。从她时常向罗德岛上的其他萨尔贡干员讨教这一点上，可以看出她并不只是嘴上说说而已。

【训练室语音记录】
“你不觉得哈蒂娅小姐和其他萨尔贡战士的对话很有意思吗？”
“怎么说？”
“她总是想弄明白武器的使用方式，它们的结构是什么样的，适用于什么作战环境，于是就一直在问类似的问题。
“但大部分时候对面只用一句话回答她。
“‘别管那些，砍就对了。’”

text.en:
The experience of growing up in Columbia will always be part of her. As she has often told other operators in the Sargon area, she knew that she was destined to come to this wilderness, but she also knows that it will hard to shake her Columbian habits, even once the glory of the Qarnsayf is restored.

'I grew up in a small community in a nomadic city,' said Hadiya while chatting with other operators during break time. 'It wasn't a very wealthy district, but it was always lively, with people coming from all kinds of places, and Sargon is just one of them.
'Every group has its own unique customs, character, and views. To me, though, it always felt so cohesive.
'Everyone's habits and pastimes had become Columbianized. Watching Wrankwood movies over soda and fried fowlbeast, making a fuss during district elections, and so on.
'The movies were great though! I should bring the latest pop music next time.'

While Hadiya is happy to talk about the culture and customs of Columbia, she has never shown an intention to import them to Sargon. When asked about the reason, she said she did not want to do so, because it would ruin the purity of Sargon in her mind.
In her veneration of the wilderness, she is, indeed, a proper Sargonian—a remark from many of her colleagues.
text.zh:
在哥伦比亚成长的经历对于哈蒂娅来说，是绝对无法从她生命中剥离的东西。正如她自己多次向萨尔贡驻地的干员们提起的那样，她知道自己命中注定要来到这片荒野上，但她也明白即便到了剑角部族重拾荣光的那一天，自己的哥伦比亚式的习惯也很难改变。

“我生在一个杂居社区。”哈蒂娅在某一天休息时，和干员们聊起自己的身世，“那是个移动城市里不太繁华的街区，但很热闹。来自各地的人都有，萨尔贡出身的人只是其中一小部分。
“每个族群都有独特的习俗，性格呀观念呀都不太一样，但要我说，那是个很有凝聚力的街区。
“因为大家的娱乐方式、日常生活习惯都已经是哥伦比亚式的了。喝着气泡水吃着油炸羽兽肉，一起看蓝卡坞的电影，等到区选举的时候还要去参加人声鼎沸的活动。
“那些电影真的很棒，对了，下次我应该带些最新的流行音乐给你们听。”

虽说如此，哈蒂娅一直以来都只是纯粹地分享，她从未表现出要把哥伦比亚的文化和习俗带到萨尔贡的意愿。当被问及这一点的时候，她明确表示不想那样做，因为那样会破坏她心中纯净的萨尔贡。
在坚守“敬畏荒野”的信念这一块她确实像个货真价实的萨尔贡人，这是很多与她共事过的干员对她的评价。

text.en:
Hadiya went through many hardships when rebuilding her tribe.
The name Qarnsayf exists only in historical records. Their territory no longer exists, nor have they left behind any extant relics, or first-hand witnesses to their exploits. This is why many lords ameer privately harbor doubts about the veracity of the legendary tribe's existence, even though The Book of Sargon contains detailed records of the Qarnsayf and their battles.
Hadiya's father's generation claimed to be the descendants of the Qarnsayf, and passed down their ancestors' teachings and the responsibility of rebuilding the tribe to hers. Although their appearance matches the depictions of the Qarnsayf in the records, and it is true that many Qarnsayf tribesmen left Sargon to become mercenaries, this is hardly enough to convince the Padishah to grant them new territory, much less make their name known throughout the tribes.
The local Padishah's challenge presented even more obstacles to her path. In order to earn the Padishah's trust and have him officially recognize the tribe and its territory, Hadiya must earn the recommendation of fifteen lords ameer and obtain their tokens—no mean feat when each one has a different demand. Defeating a lord ameer's guards in combat is merely the first step: some would not even give her the opportunity until she passed a test of history, which is hardly her strong suit. As such, at this time, Hadiya has only earned the approval of two lords ameer who allowed her to challenge their soldiers directly, and there is a long way to go until she completes the Padishah's task.
Hadiya has never complained about this. She is often seen in the break room watching Columbian movies, or chatting with colleagues about city life, showing no sign of worry about the progress of the challenge.
When others ask about it, her answer is this: If you fail, try again until you succeed.
She has never doubted that she will succeed.
text.zh:
哈蒂娅重建部族的进程并不顺利。
剑角部族是一个如今仅留于书面记载的部族，在如今的萨尔贡，既不存在其领地，也没有流传的遗物，甚至连亲身见证其传奇事迹的幸存者也早已消失。这也是为何虽然《萨尔贡史》之中有对剑角部族及其战斗功绩的明确记载，许多王酋私下里依然对这个传说中的部族是否真实存在过表示怀疑。
哈蒂娅的父辈自称是剑角部族的传人，并将先祖的教诲以及重建部族的使命传给了她这一代。虽然从外貌上，她与父辈都符合记载中对剑角部族战士形象的描绘，且剑角部族作为一个佣兵部族确实有不少族人离开了萨尔贡本土。但仅凭这些证据很难说服沙漠中的帕夏赐予剑角部族新领地，更遑论在部族之间传播剑角的威名了。
而让她的前路变得更加险阻重重的，就是当地帕夏提出的挑战。为了得到帕夏的信任，获得他亲自授予的部族领地和名号，哈蒂娅必须获得至少十五位王酋的认可，也就是从十五位王酋手上拿到证明的信物。但想要获得王酋们的信物并不容易，因为不同地区的王酋们提出的要求也不尽相同。作为战士战胜王酋亲兵只是最基本的挑战，在此之外有些王酋还会提出历史文书知识的比拼，只有通过了知识试炼他们才会同意哈蒂娅参加擂台赛挑战自己的亲兵。而书面知识从来都不是她的强项，因此哈蒂娅目前仅仅得到了两位愿意让她直接与亲兵作战的王酋的认可，距离达成帕夏的目标还非常遥远。
哈蒂娅对此没有过一句怨言。相反，在萨尔贡办事处，还能经常看到她在休息室悠闲地看着哥伦比亚电影，或是在训练之后开心地和同事们闲聊着自己的城市生活，似乎并不对挑战的进展感到担忧。
其他干员问起这件事情的时候，她只回答说，失败了的话做到成功为止不就好了。
她从不怀疑自己最终能够成功。

text.en:
[Columbian Department of Immigration Audio Log 044]
'Here are the reports on the ten Sargonians. Well, nine Sargonians now.'
'What happened?'
'One was deathly ill before crossing the border. Already dead by the time the troops found them.'
'Where are they? Still in custody?'
'Yes. It's a band of wandering mercenaries, not immigrants who entered through official channels. The military has concerns about their background and doesn't want to let them in.'
'Why don't they just deport them? Why hand them over to us?'
'Deport them where? Their employer, well, doesn't exist anymore, so that's out of the question. And the situation in Sargon is pretty chaotic right now. These ten seem to be from the same tribe, and most likely from somewhere our intel indicates a massacre occurred. The military is concerned that they might resort to desperate measures if not handled properly. I was there at the detention center, and I saw the kind of look in their eyes you only see in people who've seen hell. I'd only seen it in veterans of the Revolutionary War before.'
'So General Sfax doesn't want to be responsible for whatever happens if they're let loose. They want us to make the decision.'
'Do you want to review the report?'
'No need. Tell the general to let them in. Our mission is to absorb different types of immigrants from various places, and these Sargonians fit our needs.'
'Yes, sir, I'll let him know.'
'One more thing. Mark their papers and file them under 'Special Immigrants.' For reference when drafting future management policies.'
'Yes, sir.'
text.zh:
【哥伦比亚移民管理处录音记录转写文本第044号】
“这是有关那十个萨尔贡人的具体报告，应该说，现在是九个。”
“怎么回事？”
“其中有一个在穿越边境线之前就已经病得不轻了，等到被军队找到的时候早就咽气了。”
“现在他们人呢？还在临时羁押？”
“是的，这群人应该是流浪雇佣兵，不是正规渠道进来的移民，加上军方对他们的背景也不是很放心，不想放他们入境。”
“如果军方不愿意的话，直接遣返他们不就得了，干嘛要移交我们这边管？”
“问题就是，军方也不知道该遣返他们到哪里去。他们的上一任雇主，呃，已经不存在了，所以想把他们遣返回原雇主那边肯定行不通。萨尔贡那边的局势也极度混乱，从我们的调查来看，这十个人应该来自同一个部族，而且很有可能来自情报部门报告的那起大屠杀的区域。军队那边担心，如果不遣返，直接拒绝他们入境，很有可能会逼迫这群人铤而走险。毕竟，我也去羁押所见过这群人，确实看上去就不是普通移民，他们眼神里的那种只有在死地中摸爬滚打过的人才有的凶狠劲儿，我只在那些参与过独立战争的老兵身上看到过。”
“明白了，斯法克斯将军就是想着万一出了问题，他不想承担这个把人放了的责任，要我们去做这个拍板的人。”
“那报告您还需要过目吗？”
“不用，你去联系将军让他放这些人入境。我们接到的任务也是尽量多吸纳不同类型的各地移民，这些萨尔贡人很符合我们的需求。”
“明白了，我这就去联络。”
“稍等一下，在这群人的档案上做好标记，归档在‘特殊移民’里，以后制定移民管理策略的时候需要参考。”
“收到！”

text.en:
She could hardly feel her legs anymore.
Through the swaying light of the firepot, she looked at the lord ameer sitting behind the table, who was gazing at her with narrowed eyes. She knew she had to maintain control of her body and not waver, because the slightest sign of weakness would give him an excuse to deny her hard work.
First, the trial of recitement. She used the techniques that Anat taught her.
Second, the trial of stamina. Long years of training carried her through.
At last, the duel with the lord ameer's elite guard. There was no time for rest before this last trial. Thoroughly exhausted, she faced off against the hulking shieldguard. None of the faces illuminated by firelight were cheering for her. She could hear the crowd roar whenever the guard parried her attacks—
'Finish her off!'
When she hooked the edge of the shield with her staff and leapt into the air with the momentum of her opponent's charge, then flicked the sword to unfold the blades and cut the guard's necklace, none of the sounds around the stage mattered anymore.
'As per our agreement, victory is mine, lord ameer.' She could feel the words in her throat, but was not sure if she actually vocalized them or not.
The reaction of the lord ameer told her that she had. It was only her third victory, with twelve more to go, but she knew she was on the right path.
She took the token and turned around to walk towards the exit. Her legs had been numb, but now they were strong again, and her steps were no longer heavy.
She left behind the light of the firepots, and gazed out at the wilderness to see the sun rising upon the horizon.
text.zh:
她的双腿已经近乎失去知觉了。
在火盆摇曳的光芒之中，她看向眼前坐在桌后的王酋，对方眯着眼审视着她。她知道自己此刻只能用意志继续坚持着，绝不能放弃对自己身体的控制。因为哪怕露出一刻的软弱，眼前这个人都有可能否定掉自己的努力。
文书诵读，阿娜特小姐教授过的技巧，全部都派上了用场。
耐力试炼，常年的训练锻炼出的体质，让她坚持到了最后。
最后一场和亲兵的对决之前，没有休息的时间，她在几乎耗尽体能的状态下，面对手持巨盾的大力士。火光中没有人为她欢呼，反倒是盾卫兵一次次挡开她的攻击的时候，她听到观赛的群众的喊声。
“把她送走！”
而当她用战杖钩住巨盾的边缘，借着盾卫兵推进的蛮力让自己跃起，而后在对手身后弹出单手剑的剑刃，割断了他脖颈上的挂链时，擂台周围的一切声音对她而言都不再重要。
“大人，按照我们的约定，是我胜了。”她感到这句话从喉咙中冒了出来，但却无法确定自己究竟有没有将它说出口。
而桌子对面王酋的反应，让她知道自己是真的做到了。虽然这仅仅是她的第三次胜利，离十五次的目标还很远，但她知道，自己走在正确的路上。
她接过信物，转身走向了门口。已经麻木的双腿不知从何处又获取了力量，她感到脚步不再沉重。
火盆的光被她留在身后，她望向外面，荒野上的黎明似乎刚刚降临。
